what: Proposed prune can count a missing ACTUAL_VERSION directory against the 8-entry retention budget
scenario_or_breakage: If install verification reports the target version but the cache directory is absent, seeding ACTUAL_VERSION before filling the retained set can leave only 7 real cached dirs after pruning, deleting one extra rollback candidate
suggested_fix: Only count ACTUAL_VERSION toward KEEP_VERSIONS when $LARCH_CACHE_DIR/$ACTUAL_VERSION is an existing cached dir; otherwise fill from real cached entries up to 8 and add an absent-target regression case
